newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's CSP offer price fixed at 15,000 lire.
newsitem.headline: Italy's CSP offer price fixed at 15,000 lire.

text.p: The price of ordinary shares in Italian hosiery company CSP International Spa, whose public share offer (OPV) begins today, has been fixed at 15,000 lire per share, a statement from CSP said.
The OPV involves 2.055 million shares, which is 25 percent of the global offer, and it will end on Tuesday.
CSP is expected to list on the stock market on about July 10 with a total of more than 33 percent of its capital being floated or 8.22 million shares.
CSP, ranked second in the domestic market, posted a 1996 net profit of 10.5 billion lire against 2.1 billion in 1995 on sales of 233.7 billion lire versus 191.3 billion.
